steps.message: Open the dialer app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i dialer"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i dialer""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dumpsys package com.google.android.dialer | grep permission"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "dumpsys package com.google.android.dialer | grep permission""
